verdict.rationale: Mercury documents yield through Treasury (up to 3.89%) and savings accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows balances held in currencies other than USD, let alone interest earned on them; the payments copy is USD-centric ("no-fee USD payments"). Single-currency treasury yield is an adjacent capability and does not deliver the multi-currency interest this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn interest on balances held in multiple currencies
